national_news.title: PM Modi Conducts Bilateral Meetings on Sidelines of BRICS Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted 15 bilateral meetings with world leaders on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Key engagements included discussions with leaders of Kazakhstan, Egypt, Indonesia, South Africa, Nigeria, and the Philippines.
The Philippines officially announced its decision to join the India-led Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI).

national_news.title: Amit Shah Addresses 52nd India Gems & Jewellery Awards in Mumbai
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards ceremony in Mumbai, emphasizing the rapid expansion of the lab-grown diamond sector.
Highlighted that the lab-grown diamond market volume is projected to grow nearly 50 times the size of the current diamond market.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to promote digital conservation of historical texts.

national_news.title: Mizoram's Bairabi-Sairang Rail Line Completes One Year of Operations
bullets: The 51.38-km Bairabi-Sairang railway line in Mizoram completed one year of operation, facilitating over 15 lakh passenger journeys.
The rail line includes 153 bridges (with the tallest measuring 114 metres high) and 45 tunnels stretching across nearly 16 kilometres.
Connects the national rail network to Mizoram near capital Aizawl via four main stations: Hortoki, Kawnpui, Mualkhang, and Sairang.

national_news.title: Bairabi-Sairang Railway Project Transforms Mizoram Logistics and Connectivity
bullets: The Bairabi-Sairang rail corridor incorporates 6 bridges exceeding 70 metres in height, with the tallest bridge being 42 metres taller than Qutub Minar.
Introduced direct premium rail links including the Sairang-Anand Vihar Rajdhani Express alongside daily passenger connections to Kolkata and Guwahati.
Handled over 2,500 freight wagons delivering essential construction materials, foodgrains, fertilizers, and automobiles to the North-Eastern state.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Raksha University Hosts BRICS AML/CFT Capacity Building Programme
bullets: Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU), an Institution of National Importance, hosted a 5-day BRICS Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) training programme at its Lavad campus.
The programme focused on FATF methodologies, 11 Immediate Outcomes, emerging digital risks, virtual assets, and cross-border security compliance.
Key dignitaries included RRU VC Bimal N. Patel, Suhel Ajaz Khan (MEA), Smarak Swain (Director, FATF Cell, Ministry of Finance), and Seychelles High Commissioner Lalatiana Accouche.

national_news.title: PM Chairs BRICS Session on Inclusive Global Governance at 18th BRICS Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the session on 'Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism' during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
PM proposed establishing a Seafarers Emergency Support Network and highlighted empowering the Global South from 'rule-taker to rule-shaper' alongside reforms in the UN Security Council.
The session concluded with the formal adoption of the New Delhi BRICS Leaders' Declaration.

national_news.title: Ministry of Social Justice Expands Infrastructure and Welfare Schemes for Senior Citizens
bullets: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment sanctioned 142 new Senior Citizen Homes across the country to strengthen institutional elderly care infrastructure.
Around 23.93 lakh free assistive living devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, spectacles) were distributed to BPL/low-income senior citizens across 228 specialized camps.
The President of India launched the Senior Citizen's Welfare Portal as a consolidated one-stop information platform for elderly care services.

national_news.title: BRICS Summit Spotlights Dravidian Architecture at Bharat Mandapam
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit hosted world leaders at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi against the backdrop of a grand corridor replicating the Rameswaram temple.
The architectural display featured the distinctive Dravidian architectural style of Tamil Nadu's Ramanathaswamy Temple.
Similar to the G20 Summit in 2023 which showcased Odisha's Konark Temple, India's multilateral presidencies are utilized to highlight regional heritage to global audiences.

national_news.title: Amit Shah Urges Industry to Capture Entire Value Chain of Lab-Grown Diamonds
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards in Mumbai, emphasizing self-reliance across the entire lab-grown diamond ecosystem.
Stated that the volume of the lab-grown diamond market is expected to expand nearly 50 times compared to the current diamond market size.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to encourage manuscript conservation via modern technology.

national_news.title: BRICS Leaders Adopt New Delhi Declaration and Condemn Pahalgam Terror Attack
bullets: BRICS leaders unanimously adopted the New Delhi Declaration on the opening day of the BRICS Summit hosted under India's chairship.
The bloc condemned the April 2025 terrorist attack in Pahalgam, Jammu and Kashmir, reaffirming a policy of zero tolerance for terrorism in all forms.
The declaration urged member nations to act against cross-border movement of terrorists, terror financing, safe havens, and UN-designated terrorist entities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Urges Assistant Professors to Ensure 75% Student Attendance
bullets: Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary addressed newly appointed assistant professors, urging them to ensure at least 75% student attendance in degree colleges.
The state government recently established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, particularly in rural areas.
Highlighted that Bihar spends over 21% of its total state budget on the education sector, spanning primary, secondary, and higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Send 100 Professors to Oxford and Global Institutions for Training
bullets: Bihar government announced a plan to select 100 college professors and send them for 1-month training programs at Oxford and other reputed global universities.
The initiative aims to expose state educators to international teaching standards and facilitate experience-sharing with global academic experts.
The initiative was unveiled during the orientation program for 2,451 assistant professors recruited across 211 newly created degree colleges in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Key Initiatives in Higher Education and Model Schools
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister inaugurated an orientation programme for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 newly created degree colleges, making Bihar the first state to launch 211 degree colleges in a single day.
The state announced the development of 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools to provide quality education along with NEET/JEE coaching, live classes, and 24x7 online tutoring.
An initiative was announced to send 100 selected professors for training to top global institutions including Oxford University, backed by an allocation of 21% of the state budget to education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches Model School Development & Educator Training Programs
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary inaugurated an orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 degree colleges at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna.
Announced the development of 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools offering NEET and JEE competitive exam coaching, live classes, and 24x7 online tutoring.
Reiterated plans to send 100 professors to Oxford University for global exposure and professional training, supported by 21% state budget allocation for the education sector.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Sets 75% Attendance Goal and Plans Global Exposure for College Faculty
bullets: The Bihar government has established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, especially in rural areas.
The state government announced plans to identify 100 college teachers to send abroad for one-month training courses at top international institutions.
Bihar currently allocates over 21% of its annual state budget towards the education sector, spanning primary schools to higher education institutions.
